changelog.name: Release v2.0.0-beta-1
changelog.body:
Release v2.0.0-beta-1

⚠️ Note on this Initial Release:
Since this is the very first public build of the completely new V2 architecture, expect bugs. Some features might not work exactly as expected right now.

What’s Next?
This is a fresh open-source start. I will be working on it and pushing improvements on a daily basis. Very soon, with your testing and feedback, this project will reach its highly stable and optimal state.

Thank you for your incredible patience and support. Go check out the new repo, drop a ⭐ to support the project, and let the new journey begin!

changelog.name: WaEnhancerX v1.7.0
changelog.body:
[Added]
- Added support for WhatsApp versions up to 2.26.27.xx (WA/WB)
- WhatsApp Native Embedded Settings UI following WhatsApp Design
- Integrated hardware-tied licensing framework and companion plugin system
- [Pro] Always Typing & Always Recording status options
- [Pro] Message Bomber utility with customizable delays
- [Pro] Local storage Media Deletion options
- [Pro] Status Splitter for posting long videos automatically
- [Pro] Status view controls (rewind/forward, speed, hide reply/reactions)
- User option to load message text as selectable inside chat bubbles
- Toggle option to hide the Meta AI tab on Home Screen
- Option to set custom message forwarding limits
- Option to specify user-defined WA/WB versions

[Improved]
- Migrated Pro features to modular helper plugin for GPL 3.0 compliance
- Enhanced Edited message history to highlight exact changes (diff visualization)
- Relocated New Chat to Home FAB long-press with localized country hints
- Optimized SQLite queries and scroll performance with custom indexing
- Cleaned up package size and removed unused native dependencies (DexKit)

[Fixes]
- Fixed Seen Ticks (Hide Blue Ticks) on newer WhatsApp versions
- Fixed default emoji rendering and related system crashes
- Fixed ShareLimit and GroupAdmin plugin startup errors
- Fixed text status custom color and module active state detection on some devices
- Fixed edit message history to persist all versions instead of only two

[Notes]
- This update may clear old edited message history.
- Embedded Settings are not fully completed, more features will be added in future updates.
- Your support is appreciated! <3

changelog.name: WaEnhancerX-v1.6.9
changelog.body:
[Added]
- **WhatsApp Support**:
  - Full compatibility with WA/WB versions up to **2.26.23.xx**.
- **Floating Bottom Navigation Bar**:
  - Implemented a smooth floating pill-shaped bottom navigation bar with layout adjustments and transitions.
- **WaEnhancerX Pro Features**:
  - Introduced the premium license verification framework tied to device hardware (via Telegram bot `@waenhancerx_bot`).
  - **Always Typing [Pro]**: Added *Always Typing* and *Always Recording Voice* states.
  - **Message Bomber [Pro]**: Added a message-bombing utility with adjustable delays.
  - **Media Deletion [Pro]**: Added option to completely delete message media files directly from local storage.
  - **Status Splitter [Pro]**: Implemented a status video splitter with full obfuscation support to automatically post long status videos.
  - **Status View Customizations [Pro]**: Custom status playback controls, layouts, fast-forward/rewind gestures, playback speed controllers, play/pause buttons, and options to hide/disable reply bars, quick reactions, and heart buttons.
- **General Enhancements**:
  - Added option to make message text selectable inside chat bubbles.
  - Added toggle to hide the new Meta AI tab on the Home Screen.
  - Added user configuration to select between embedded settings inside WhatsApp or launch as an external standalone application.
  - Added a multi-step "Report Issue" flow with title input and validation checks.

[Improvements]
- **Database & Query Performance**:
  - Integrated a one-time database index optimization to resolve lags (especially when the *Separate Groups* feature is active).
  - Optimized conversation scrolling performance.
- **UX & Design Polish**:
  - Rounded custom bottom sheets and alert dialog buttons to match modern pill-shaped designs.
- **App Size Reduction**:
  - Decoupled `App.java` from licensing using dynamic reflection, purged verbose debug logs, and removed the unused native `DexKit` dependency to decrease package size.

[Fixes]
- **Media & Audio**:
  - Fixed sending local media files as voice notes and resolved transcoding issues with the Audio-to-Opus utility.
  - Fixed crashes in `AudioPlayerDialog` when loading corrupt or unplayable audio files.
- **Seen Ticks & Online Status**:
  - Resolved seen tick (Hide Blue Ticks) issues.
  - Fixed Hide Typing & Recording voice status hooks.
- **Compatibility & Crash Fixes**:
  - Resolved `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` exceptions in Xposed initialization.
  - Fixed nested preference fragment crashes and navigation errors.
  - Implemented fallback method-resolution logic in `Unobfuscator` for floating action button hook failures.
  - Restored chat date separators (Today, Yesterday, etc.) that were missing under time customization.

# WaEnhancer X

WaEnhancer X is a powerful Xposed/LSPosed module that supercharges your WhatsApp experience with advanced privacy, customization, and utility features.

[![Telegram](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerx&label=Channel&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerx) [![Telegram](https://telegram-badge.pages.dev/api/telegram-badge?channelId=@waenhancerxhub&label=Community&showOnline=true)](https://t.me/waenhancerxhub)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Android-green.svg) ![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-LSPosed%20%7C%20Zygisk-orange.svg) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active%20Development-success.svg) ## Important notice Please read this section before installing or using the project. - **Educational use:** WaEnhancerX is a proof-of-concept project intended for research, Android reverse-engineering, and UI/UX experimentation. - **No affiliation:** This project is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Meta Platforms, WhatsApp LLC, or any of their subsidiaries. - **Use at your own risk:** Modifying an official app may violate its terms of service. The developers are not responsible for account restrictions, data loss, device instability, or other problems caused by using this module. ## About V2 WaEnhancerX V2 is an independent, clean-room rewrite built from scratch. - It is not a fork of V1 or another third-party module. - It does not reuse code, logic, or file structures from earlier versions or GPL-licensed projects. - Its hooking system is designed for stability on modern Android versions, including Android 12 through Android 15 and later. - The project is available under the Apache License 2.0. ## Features - **Meta AI cleanup:** Removes supported Meta AI interface elements from chats and action buttons. - **Custom view engine:** Lets you change backgrounds, chat bubble colors, and layouts using CSS-like rules. - **Integrated settings:** Adds WaEnhancerX options to the app's native settings interface, including search support. - **Privacy tools:** - Prevent incoming messages from being removed when their sender deletes them. - Open and save view-once media. - Keep a local history of messages you delete for yourself. - **Tasker support (Soon):** Control supported privacy settings and actions through Android intent broadcasts. ## Requirements Before installing WaEnhancerX, make sure your device has: 1. Root access through Magisk or KernelSU. 2. Zygisk enabled and a working LSPosed installation. EdXposed is not supported. 3. A supported version of the official WhatsApp app from Google Play. ## Installation 1. Download the latest `WaEnhancerX-v2.x.x.apk` from the [Releases page](../../releases). 2. Install the APK on your device. 3. Open LSPosed Manager and enable the WaEnhancerX module. 4. Select System Framework and WhatsApp in the module's scope. 5. Reboot your device. 6. Open WhatsApp and find the WaEnhancerX options in the main settings menu. ## License WaEnhancerX is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). You may use, modify, and distribute it in open-source or proprietary projects as long as you include the original copyright notice and a copy of the license. Copyright 2026 Mubashar Dev
